summary: Ericsson filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly share buybacks under its previously announced SEK 15B buyback program running April 23, 2026 to March 31, 2027. During May 18-22, 2026, it repurchased 2,523,000 Class B shares at a weighted average price of SEK 121.93 per share. The program is conducted on Nasdaq Stockholm via Goldman Sachs under EU safe harbor rules. The Board intends to propose cancellation of repurchased shares at the 2027 AGM. This is a routine open-market buyback, not a tender offer or special capital return event. Watch for continued execution pace relative to program cap.
